Market today: Bond yields are ticking higher, which is the real driver here, putting pressure on growth names. My kind of tech/chip stocks are sensitive to this.

Your holdings: SOXL (-27.35%) and SPAL (-25.13%) are flagged for attention. They are leveraged ETFs and are currently in the red, and margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: The rising bond yields and their impact on tech valuations.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching the bond market.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming if it breaks below 162.04, its scanner stop.
SPAL: Watch the 18.83 price point; a break below could signal further downside.
No new buys today - hold and watch
